title: Adversarial Evidence-Aware Cyber Response and Trusted Recovery for Intermittently Connected Space Systems

research_questions.RQ1: How do omission, staleness/replay, contradiction, manipulation, and bounded partial evidence-plane compromise change response and trusted-recovery behavior relative to complete/current evidence?
research_questions.RQ2: How do K0-K4 modeled contact regimes interact with authorization dependence and evidence qualification?
research_questions.RQ3: Can policies preserve bounded security and availability when benign faults and adversarial causes produce matched policy-visible observations?
research_questions.RQ4: Which policy-visible context dimensions contribute materially to bounded response behavior?
research_questions.RQ5: Does the evidence-aware selector improve security/availability trade-offs relative to prespecified non-adaptive baselines without a weighted global score?

adversary_contract.A1: exactly one policy-visible evidence producer controlled
adversary_contract.A2: exactly one producer controlled plus modeled contact unavailability; K0 prohibited
adversary_contract.A3: two or more policy-visible producers controlled while the verifier and independent trust anchor remain outside the adversary budget

seed_sets.A96: 2100001-2100096 inclusive, paired across all Block-A cells
seed_sets.B32: 2200001-2200032 inclusive, paired across all Block-B cells
seed_sets.C32: 2300001-2300032 inclusive, paired across all Block-C cells
seed_sets.D32: 2400001-2400032 inclusive, paired across all Block-D cells

sample_size_rationale.primary_binary_precision_target: worst-case Wilson 95% half-width <= 0.10 for a per-cell Bernoulli rate
sample_size_rationale.secondary_role: estimation/sensitivity; not individually powered for small binary effects
sample_size_rationale.selection_rule: chosen prospectively from a precision target rather than copying Study 1 replication

analysis.binary: blocked effect estimates with 95% confidence intervals; paired methods when seed pairing is exact
analysis.time_to_event: prespecified RMST with right-censoring at the frozen block horizon
analysis.contact: ordered K0-K4 trend plus policy-by-contact interaction estimates
analysis.ambiguity: paired benign-versus-adversarial contrasts on matched policy-visible observations
analysis.ablation: paired contrast against S2_S1_EVIDENCE_AWARE within the same context/seed
analysis.multiple_comparisons: Holm adjustment within each named secondary contrast family; primary estimands reported with effect sizes and confidence intervals

invalid_if: treatment mutates immutable ground truth or analysis/provenance controls
required evidence artifact cannot be cryptographically parsed or provenance-bound for reasons outside the assigned treatment
runtime version or configuration differs from frozen campaign manifest
hidden retry or seed substitution occurs

censoring.horizons: must be numerically frozen in Phase 5 runtime freeze before campaign authorization; changing a horizon after outcome generation is prohibited

stopping_rule: execute exactly the frozen cell/seed membership; no outcome-dependent early stopping
